"""Offline contracts only; no provider, installer, or execution surface."""

__version__ = "0.0.0"

"""Closed, immutable fixture contracts; parsed observations are never authority."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any, Callable

SYNTHETIC_MODEL = "fixture-claude-v1"
MAX_JSON_DEPTH = 32
READ_TOOLS = frozenset({"Read", "Glob", "Grep"})
ROLES = frozenset({
    "claude_agents_researcher", "claude_agents_planner",
    "claude_agents_implementation_worker", "claude_agents_security_reviewer",
    "claude_agents_verification_worker",
})
STATES = frozenset({"pre-send", "sent", "acknowledged", "terminal", "ambiguous"})
_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}\Z")
_VERSION = re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{1,5}\Z")
_PATH_PART = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}\Z")


class ContractError(ValueError):
    """Content-free code: callers must not append rejected input to diagnostics."""

    def __init__(self, code: str) -> None:
        self.code = code
        super().__init__(code)


def reject(code: str) -> None:
    raise ContractError(code)


def _record(value: Any, fields: str, *, versioned: bool = True) -> dict:
    if type(value) is not dict or set(value) != set(fields.split()):
        reject("invalid_fields")
    if versioned and (type(value["schema_version"]) is not int
                      or value["schema_version"] != 1):
        reject("unsupported_schema")
    return value


def _text(value: Any, maximum: int = 4096) -> str:
    if (type(value) is not str or not value.strip() or len(value) > maximum
            or any(ord(c) < 32 and c not in "\n\t" for c in value)):
        reject("invalid_text")
    return value


def _identifier(value: Any) -> str:
    if type(value) is not str or not _ID.fullmatch(value):
        reject("invalid_identifier")
    return value


def relative_path(value: Any) -> str:
    """Canonical literal root-relative token, not a filesystem reference monitor."""
    if (type(value) is not str or len(value) > 256
            or any(p in {"", ".", ".."} or not _PATH_PART.fullmatch(p)
                   for p in value.split("/"))):
        reject("invalid_path")
    return value


def _choice(value: Any, choices: set | frozenset) -> str:
    if type(value) is not str or value not in choices:
        reject("unsupported_value")
    return value


def _integer(value: Any, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> int:
    if type(value) is not int or not minimum <= value <= maximum:
        reject("invalid_number")
    return value


def _boolean(value: Any) -> bool:
    if type(value) is not bool:
        reject("invalid_boolean")
    return value


def _sequence(value: Any, parser: Callable, minimum: int = 0,
              maximum: int = 32) -> tuple:
    if type(value) is not list or not minimum <= len(value) <= maximum:
        reject("invalid_array")
    result = tuple(parser(item) for item in value)
    if len(result) != len(set(result)):
        reject("duplicate_item")
    return result


def _empty(value: Any) -> tuple:
    if type(value) is not list or value:
        reject("capability_denied")
    return ()


def _disabled(value: Any) -> bool:
    if _boolean(value):
        reject("capability_denied")
    return False


def _version(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if type(value) is not str or not _VERSION.fullmatch(value):
        reject("invalid_version")
    return value


def safe_load_json(text: str) -> Any:
    """Bound input/depth; reject duplicate keys and floating/nonfinite numbers."""
    if type(text) is not str or len(text) > 131072:
        reject("invalid_json")
    depth, quoted, escaped = 0, False, False
    for character in text:
        if quoted:
            if escaped:
                escaped = False
            elif character == "\\":
                escaped = True
            elif character == '"':
                quoted = False
        elif character == '"':
            quoted = True
        elif character in "[{":
            depth += 1
            if depth > MAX_JSON_DEPTH:
                reject("invalid_json")
        elif character in "]}":
            depth -= 1

    def pairs(items: list) -> dict:
        result = {}
        for key, value in items:
            if key in result:
                reject("duplicate_key")
            result[key] = value
        return result

    def number(_: str) -> None:
        reject("invalid_number")

    try:
        return json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_float=number,
                          parse_constant=number)
    except (ValueError, RecursionError) as exc:
        if isinstance(exc, ContractError):
            raise
        raise ContractError("invalid_json") from None


def to_wire(value: Any) -> dict:
    """Return a detached JSON-shaped copy; tuple fields become arrays."""
    try:
        return json.loads(json.dumps(asdict(value), allow_nan=False))
    except (TypeError, ValueError, RecursionError):
        raise ContractError("invalid_contract") from None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Bounds:
    max_attempts: int
    timeout_seconds: int
    max_tool_calls: int
    max_no_progress_events: int


def _bounds(value: Any) -> Bounds:
    d = _record(value, "max_attempts timeout_seconds max_tool_calls "
                "max_no_progress_events", versioned=False)
    return Bounds(_integer(d["max_attempts"], 1, 1),
                  _integer(d["timeout_seconds"], 1, 3600),
                  _integer(d["max_tool_calls"], 0, 128),
                  _integer(d["max_no_progress_events"], 1, 16))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Capabilities:
    tools: tuple[str, ...]
    read_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    network: bool
    mcps: tuple
    hooks: tuple
    secrets: tuple
    external_effects: bool


def _capabilities(value: Any) -> Capabilities:
    d = _record(value, "tools read_paths network mcps hooks secrets external_effects",
                versioned=False)
    return Capabilities(
        _sequence(d["tools"], lambda v: _choice(v, READ_TOOLS), maximum=3),
        _sequence(d["read_paths"], relative_path),
        _disabled(d["network"]), _empty(d["mcps"]), _empty(d["hooks"]),
        _empty(d["secrets"]), _disabled(d["external_effects"]),
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Task:
    schema_version: int
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    objective: str
    family: str
    owned_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    required_evidence: tuple[str, ...]


def parse_task(value: Any) -> Task:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version task_id job_id objective family owned_paths "
                "required_evidence")
    return Task(
        1, _identifier(d["task_id"]), _identifier(d["job_id"]),
        _text(d["objective"]),
        _choice(d["family"], {"inventory", "research", "planning", "coding",
                             "documentation", "security", "verification"}),
        _sequence(d["owned_paths"], relative_path, 1),
        _sequence(d["required_evidence"], _identifier, 1),
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ParentGrant:
    schema_version: int
    grant_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    capabilities: Capabilities
    bounds: Bounds


def parse_parent_grant(value: Any) -> ParentGrant:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version grant_id task_id job_id capabilities bounds")
    return ParentGrant(1, _identifier(d["grant_id"]), _identifier(d["task_id"]),
                       _identifier(d["job_id"]), _capabilities(d["capabilities"]),
                       _bounds(d["bounds"]))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Assignment:
    schema_version: int
    assignment_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    attempt_id: str
    attempt: int
    parent_grant_id: str
    role: str
    requested_model: str
    context_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    capabilities: Capabilities
    bounds: Bounds
    required_evidence: tuple[str, ...]
    lifecycle_state: str


def _assignment_shape(value: Any) -> Assignment:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version assignment_id task_id job_id attempt_id "
                "attempt parent_grant_id role requested_model context_paths "
                "capabilities bounds required_evidence lifecycle_state")
    a = Assignment(
        1, _identifier(d["assignment_id"]), _identifier(d["task_id"]),
        _identifier(d["job_id"]), _identifier(d["attempt_id"]),
        _integer(d["attempt"], 1, 1), _identifier(d["parent_grant_id"]),
        _choice(d["role"], ROLES), _identifier(d["requested_model"]),
        _sequence(d["context_paths"], relative_path),
        _capabilities(d["capabilities"]), _bounds(d["bounds"]),
        _sequence(d["required_evidence"], _identifier, 1),
        _choice(d["lifecycle_state"], STATES),
    )
    if a.requested_model != SYNTHETIC_MODEL:
        reject("synthetic_model_required")
    return a


def parse_assignment(value: Any, *, task: Task, parent: ParentGrant) -> Assignment:
    task = parse_task(to_wire(task))
    parent = parse_parent_grant(to_wire(parent))
    a = _assignment_shape(value)
    if (a.task_id != task.task_id or a.job_id != task.job_id
            or parent.task_id != task.task_id or parent.job_id != task.job_id
            or a.parent_grant_id != parent.grant_id):
        reject("identity_mismatch")
    if a.required_evidence != task.required_evidence:
        reject("evidence_mismatch")
    if (not set(a.capabilities.tools) <= set(parent.capabilities.tools)
            or not set(a.capabilities.read_paths) <= set(parent.capabilities.read_paths)
            or not set(a.context_paths) <= set(a.capabilities.read_paths)
            or not set(a.capabilities.read_paths) <= set(task.owned_paths)):
        reject("grant_expansion")
    if any(v > getattr(parent.bounds, key)
           for key, v in asdict(a.bounds).items()):
        reject("bound_expansion")
    return a


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Usage:
    schema_version: int
    source: str
    coverage: str
    input_tokens: int | None
    cached_tokens: int | None
    output_tokens: int | None
    reasoning_tokens: int | None
    tool_calls: int | None
    latency_ms: int | None


def parse_usage(value: Any) -> Usage | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    names = ("input_tokens", "cached_tokens", "output_tokens",
             "reasoning_tokens", "tool_calls", "latency_ms")
    d = _record(value, "schema_version source coverage " + " ".join(names))
    source = _choice(d["source"], {"synthetic", "unavailable"})
    coverage = _choice(d["coverage"], {"unknown", "partial", "complete"})
    numbers = tuple(None if d[k] is None else _integer(d[k], 0, 1000000000)
                    for k in names)
    if (source == "unavailable" and (coverage != "unknown"
                                    or any(v is not None for v in numbers))):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    if coverage == "unknown" and any(v is not None for v in numbers):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    if coverage == "complete" and any(v is None for v in numbers):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    for total, subset in ((numbers[0], numbers[1]), (numbers[2], numbers[3])):
        if subset is not None and (total is None or subset > total):
            reject("invalid_usage_subset")
    return Usage(1, source, coverage, *numbers)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Evidence:
    criterion_id: str
    type: str
    reference: str
    outcome: str
    details: str


def _evidence(value: Any) -> Evidence:
    d = _record(value, "criterion_id type reference outcome details", versioned=False)
    return Evidence(
        _identifier(d["criterion_id"]),
        _choice(d["type"], {"command", "source", "artifact", "review", "observation"}),
        _text(d["reference"], 512),
        _choice(d["outcome"], {"pass", "fail", "observed", "not_run"}),
        _text(d["details"]),
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Result:
    schema_version: int
    assignment_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    attempt_id: str
    requested_model: str
    resolved_model: str
    execution_state: str
    semantic_verdict: str
    admission_state: str
    summary: str
    artifacts: tuple[str, ...]
    evidence: tuple[Evidence, ...]
    unverified_claims: tuple[str, ...]
    remaining_risks: tuple[str, ...]
    usage: Usage | None


def parse_result(value: Any, *, assignment: Assignment) -> Result:
    assignment = _assignment_shape(to_wire(assignment))
    d = _record(value, "schema_version assignment_id task_id job_id attempt_id "
                "requested_model resolved_model execution_state semantic_verdict "
                "admission_state summary artifacts evidence unverified_claims "
                "remaining_risks usage")
    result = Result(
        1, *(_identifier(d[k]) for k in ("assignment_id", "task_id", "job_id",
                                        "attempt_id", "requested_model",
                                        "resolved_model")),
        _choice(d["execution_state"], {"completed", "failed", "timed_out",
                                      "interrupted", "cancelled", "invalid"}),
        _choice(d["semantic_verdict"], {"pass", "ready", "ready-with-corrections",
                                       "not-ready", "blocked", "reject",
                                       "not-applicable"}),
        _choice(d["admission_state"], {"unverified"}), _text(d["summary"]),
        _sequence(d["artifacts"], relative_path),
        _sequence(d["evidence"], _evidence),
        _sequence(d["unverified_claims"], _text),
        _sequence(d["remaining_risks"], _text), parse_usage(d["usage"]),
    )
    if any(getattr(result, k) != getattr(assignment, k)
           for k in ("assignment_id", "task_id", "job_id", "attempt_id",
                     "requested_model")):
        reject("identity_mismatch")
    if result.resolved_model != assignment.requested_model:
        reject("model_mismatch")
    criteria = tuple(e.criterion_id for e in result.evidence)
    if (len(criteria) != len(set(criteria))
            or not set(criteria) <= set(assignment.required_evidence)):
        reject("invalid_evidence")
    if result.execution_state == "completed":
        if set(criteria) != set(assignment.required_evidence):
            reject("missing_evidence")
    if result.semantic_verdict in {"pass", "ready"}:
        if (result.execution_state != "completed" or result.unverified_claims
                or result.remaining_risks
                or any(e.outcome not in {"pass", "observed"} for e in result.evidence)):
            reject("inconsistent_verdict")
    return result

"""Pure offline checks. Success validates fixtures and never permits execution."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from .contracts import (
    READ_TOOLS, ROLES, Assignment, BillingObservation, ParentGrant, Task,
    VersionObservation, _record, parse_assignment, parse_billing_observation,
    parse_parent_grant, parse_task, parse_version_observation, reject, relative_path,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FixtureReadiness:
    task: Task
    parent: ParentGrant
    assignment: Assignment
    version: VersionObservation
    billing: BillingObservation
    runtime_enabled: bool = field(default=False, init=False)


def assess_fixture_readiness(value: Any) -> FixtureReadiness:
    """Synthetic structural readiness only: no real attestation or admission API."""
    d = _record(value, "schema_version task parent_grant assignment version billing")
    task = parse_task(d["task"])
    parent = parse_parent_grant(d["parent_grant"])
    assignment = parse_assignment(d["assignment"], task=task, parent=parent)
    version = parse_version_observation(d["version"])
    billing = parse_billing_observation(d["billing"])
    for observation in (version, billing):
        if (observation.assignment_id != assignment.assignment_id
                or observation.attempt_id != assignment.attempt_id):
            reject("observation_mismatch")
    if assignment.lifecycle_state != "pre-send":
        reject("attempt_not_pre_send")
    if (version.source != "synthetic" or version.channel != "latest"
            or version.client_version is None
            or version.client_version != version.latest_version
            or not version.fresh or not version.capabilities_verified):
        reject("version_unverified")
    if (billing.source != "synthetic" or billing.provider != "first_party"
            or billing.auth_method != "claude.ai"
            or billing.billing_mode != "subscription"
            or billing.usage_credits != "disabled"
            or billing.entitlement != "available" or not billing.fresh):
        reject("billing_unverified")
    return FixtureReadiness(task, parent, assignment, version, billing)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NativeFixture:
    name: str
    description: str
    tools: tuple[str, ...]
    body: str
    runtime_enabled: bool = field(default=False, init=False)


_HEADER = re.compile(r"([a-z]+): ([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 ,._/-]{0,511})\Z")
_LINK = re.compile(r"!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)")


def parse_native_fixture(text: Any) -> NativeFixture:
    """Parse our three-key scalar YAML subset, not general YAML or native discovery.

    Model omission in this inert fixture does not establish native model isolation.
    Body content is untrusted text and cannot grant tools, permissions or admission.
    """
    if type(text) is not str or len(text) > 16384 or "\r" in text:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if (len(lines) < 6 or lines[0] != "---"
            or any(ord(c) < 32 and c != "\n" for c in text)):
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    try:
        boundary = lines.index("---", 1)
    except ValueError:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    header = {}
    for line in lines[1:boundary]:
        match = _HEADER.fullmatch(line)
        if not match or match[1] in header:
            reject("invalid_native_header")
        header[match[1]] = match[2]
    if set(header) != {"name", "description", "tools"} or header["name"] not in ROLES:
        reject("invalid_native_header")
    tools = tuple(p.strip() for p in header["tools"].split(","))
    if (not tools or len(tools) != len(set(tools)) or not set(tools) <= READ_TOOLS):
        reject("native_tools_denied")
    body = "\n".join(lines[boundary + 1:]).strip()
    if not body:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    for link in _LINK.findall(body):
        relative_path(link)
    return NativeFixture(header["name"], header["description"], tools, body)


def validate_native_inventory(texts: Any) -> tuple[NativeFixture, ...]:
    """Validate exactly one inert definition for each package role."""
    if type(texts) is not list or len(texts) != len(ROLES):
        reject("invalid_native_inventory")
    fixtures = tuple(parse_native_fixture(text) for text in texts)
    names = tuple(f.name for f in fixtures)
    if len(names) != len(set(names)) or set(names) != ROLES:
        reject("invalid_native_inventory")
    return fixtures

"""Offline contracts only; no provider, installer, or execution surface."""

__version__ = "0.0.0"

"""Closed, immutable fixture contracts; parsed observations are never authority."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any, Callable

SYNTHETIC_MODEL = "fixture-claude-v1"
MAX_JSON_DEPTH = 32
READ_TOOLS = frozenset({"Read", "Glob", "Grep"})
ROLES = frozenset({
    "claude_agents_researcher", "claude_agents_planner",
    "claude_agents_implementation_worker", "claude_agents_security_reviewer",
    "claude_agents_verification_worker",
})
STATES = frozenset({"pre-send", "sent", "acknowledged", "terminal", "ambiguous"})
_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}\Z")
_VERSION = re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{1,5}\Z")
_PATH_PART = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}\Z")


class ContractError(ValueError):
    """Content-free code: callers must not append rejected input to diagnostics."""

    def __init__(self, code: str) -> None:
        self.code = code
        super().__init__(code)


def reject(code: str) -> None:
    raise ContractError(code)


def _record(value: Any, fields: str, *, versioned: bool = True) -> dict:
    if type(value) is not dict or set(value) != set(fields.split()):
        reject("invalid_fields")
    if versioned and (type(value["schema_version"]) is not int
                      or value["schema_version"] != 1):
        reject("unsupported_schema")
    return value


def _text(value: Any, maximum: int = 4096) -> str:
    if (type(value) is not str or not value.strip() or len(value) > maximum
            or any(ord(c) < 32 and c not in "\n\t" for c in value)):
        reject("invalid_text")
    return value


def _identifier(value: Any) -> str:
    if type(value) is not str or not _ID.fullmatch(value):
        reject("invalid_identifier")
    return value


def relative_path(value: Any) -> str:
    """Canonical literal root-relative token, not a filesystem reference monitor."""
    if (type(value) is not str or len(value) > 256
            or any(p in {"", ".", ".."} or not _PATH_PART.fullmatch(p)
                   for p in value.split("/"))):
        reject("invalid_path")
    return value


def _choice(value: Any, choices: set | frozenset) -> str:
    if type(value) is not str or value not in choices:
        reject("unsupported_value")
    return value


def _integer(value: Any, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> int:
    if type(value) is not int or not minimum <= value <= maximum:
        reject("invalid_number")
    return value


def _boolean(value: Any) -> bool:
    if type(value) is not bool:
        reject("invalid_boolean")
    return value


def _sequence(value: Any, parser: Callable, minimum: int = 0,
              maximum: int = 32) -> tuple:
    if type(value) is not list or not minimum <= len(value) <= maximum:
        reject("invalid_array")
    result = tuple(parser(item) for item in value)
    if len(result) != len(set(result)):
        reject("duplicate_item")
    return result


def _empty(value: Any) -> tuple:
    if type(value) is not list or value:
        reject("capability_denied")
    return ()


def _disabled(value: Any) -> bool:
    if _boolean(value):
        reject("capability_denied")
    return False


def _version(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if type(value) is not str or not _VERSION.fullmatch(value):
        reject("invalid_version")
    return value


def safe_load_json(text: str) -> Any:
    """Bound input/depth; reject duplicate keys and floating/nonfinite numbers."""
    if type(text) is not str or len(text) > 131072:
        reject("invalid_json")
    depth, quoted, escaped = 0, False, False
    for character in text:
        if quoted:
            if escaped:
                escaped = False
            elif character == "\\":
                escaped = True
            elif character == '"':
                quoted = False
        elif character == '"':
            quoted = True
        elif character in "[{":
            depth += 1
            if depth > MAX_JSON_DEPTH:
                reject("invalid_json")
        elif character in "]}":
            depth -= 1

    def pairs(items: list) -> dict:
        result = {}
        for key, value in items:
            if key in result:
                reject("duplicate_key")
            result[key] = value
        return result

    def number(_: str) -> None:
        reject("invalid_number")

    try:
        return json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_float=number,
                          parse_constant=number)
    except (ValueError, RecursionError) as exc:
        if isinstance(exc, ContractError):
            raise
        raise ContractError("invalid_json") from None


def to_wire(value: Any) -> dict:
    """Return a detached JSON-shaped copy; tuple fields become arrays."""
    try:
        return json.loads(json.dumps(asdict(value), allow_nan=False))
    except (TypeError, ValueError, RecursionError):
        raise ContractError("invalid_contract") from None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Bounds:
    max_attempts: int
    timeout_seconds: int
    max_tool_calls: int
    max_no_progress_events: int


def _bounds(value: Any) -> Bounds:
    d = _record(value, "max_attempts timeout_seconds max_tool_calls "
                "max_no_progress_events", versioned=False)
    return Bounds(_integer(d["max_attempts"], 1, 1),
                  _integer(d["timeout_seconds"], 1, 3600),
                  _integer(d["max_tool_calls"], 0, 128),
                  _integer(d["max_no_progress_events"], 1, 16))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Capabilities:
    tools: tuple[str, ...]
    read_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    network: bool
    mcps: tuple
    hooks: tuple
    secrets: tuple
    external_effects: bool


def _capabilities(value: Any) -> Capabilities:
    d = _record(value, "tools read_paths network mcps hooks secrets external_effects",
                versioned=False)
    return Capabilities(
        _sequence(d["tools"], lambda v: _choice(v, READ_TOOLS), maximum=3),
        _sequence(d["read_paths"], relative_path),
        _disabled(d["network"]), _empty(d["mcps"]), _empty(d["hooks"]),
        _empty(d["secrets"]), _disabled(d["external_effects"]),
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Task:
    schema_version: int
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    objective: str
    family: str
    owned_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    required_evidence: tuple[str, ...]


def parse_task(value: Any) -> Task:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version task_id job_id objective family owned_paths "
                "required_evidence")
    return Task(
        1, _identifier(d["task_id"]), _identifier(d["job_id"]),
        _text(d["objective"]),
        _choice(d["family"], {"inventory", "research", "planning", "coding",
                             "documentation", "security", "verification"}),
        _sequence(d["owned_paths"], relative_path, 1),
        _sequence(d["required_evidence"], _identifier, 1),
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ParentGrant:
    schema_version: int
    grant_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    capabilities: Capabilities
    bounds: Bounds


def parse_parent_grant(value: Any) -> ParentGrant:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version grant_id task_id job_id capabilities bounds")
    return ParentGrant(1, _identifier(d["grant_id"]), _identifier(d["task_id"]),
                       _identifier(d["job_id"]), _capabilities(d["capabilities"]),
                       _bounds(d["bounds"]))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Assignment:
    schema_version: int
    assignment_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    attempt_id: str
    attempt: int
    parent_grant_id: str
    role: str
    requested_model: str
    context_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    capabilities: Capabilities
    bounds: Bounds
    required_evidence: tuple[str, ...]
    lifecycle_state: str


def _assignment_shape(value: Any) -> Assignment:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version assignment_id task_id job_id attempt_id "
                "attempt parent_grant_id role requested_model context_paths "
                "capabilities bounds required_evidence lifecycle_state")
    a = Assignment(
        1, _identifier(d["assignment_id"]), _identifier(d["task_id"]),
        _identifier(d["job_id"]), _identifier(d["attempt_id"]),
        _integer(d["attempt"], 1, 1), _identifier(d["parent_grant_id"]),
        _choice(d["role"], ROLES), _identifier(d["requested_model"]),
        _sequence(d["context_paths"], relative_path),
        _capabilities(d["capabilities"]), _bounds(d["bounds"]),
        _sequence(d["required_evidence"], _identifier, 1),
        _choice(d["lifecycle_state"], STATES),
    )
    if a.requested_model != SYNTHETIC_MODEL:
        reject("synthetic_model_required")
    return a


def parse_assignment(value: Any, *, task: Task, parent: ParentGrant) -> Assignment:
    task = parse_task(to_wire(task))
    parent = parse_parent_grant(to_wire(parent))
    a = _assignment_shape(value)
    if (a.task_id != task.task_id or a.job_id != task.job_id
            or parent.task_id != task.task_id or parent.job_id != task.job_id
            or a.parent_grant_id != parent.grant_id):
        reject("identity_mismatch")
    if a.required_evidence != task.required_evidence:
        reject("evidence_mismatch")
    if (not set(a.capabilities.tools) <= set(parent.capabilities.tools)
            or not set(a.capabilities.read_paths) <= set(parent.capabilities.read_paths)
            or not set(a.context_paths) <= set(a.capabilities.read_paths)
            or not set(a.capabilities.read_paths) <= set(task.owned_paths)):
        reject("grant_expansion")
    if any(v > getattr(parent.bounds, key)
           for key, v in asdict(a.bounds).items()):
        reject("bound_expansion")
    return a


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Usage:
    schema_version: int
    source: str
    coverage: str
    input_tokens: int | None
    cached_tokens: int | None
    output_tokens: int | None
    reasoning_tokens: int | None
    tool_calls: int | None
    latency_ms: int | None


def parse_usage(value: Any) -> Usage | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    names = ("input_tokens", "cached_tokens", "output_tokens",
             "reasoning_tokens", "tool_calls", "latency_ms")
    d = _record(value, "schema_version source coverage " + " ".join(names))
    source = _choice(d["source"], {"synthetic", "unavailable"})
    coverage = _choice(d["coverage"], {"unknown", "partial", "complete"})
    numbers = tuple(None if d[k] is None else _integer(d[k], 0, 1000000000)
                    for k in names)
    if (source == "unavailable" and (coverage != "unknown"
                                    or any(v is not None for v in numbers))):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    if coverage == "unknown" and any(v is not None for v in numbers):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    if coverage == "complete" and any(v is None for v in numbers):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    for total, subset in ((numbers[0], numbers[1]), (numbers[2], numbers[3])):
        if subset is not None and (total is None or subset > total):
            reject("invalid_usage_subset")
    return Usage(1, source, coverage, *numbers)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Evidence:
    criterion_id: str
    type: str
    reference: str
    outcome: str
    details: str


def _evidence(value: Any) -> Evidence:
    d = _record(value, "criterion_id type reference outcome details", versioned=False)
    return Evidence(
        _identifier(d["criterion_id"]),
        _choice(d["type"], {"command", "source", "artifact", "review", "observation"}),
        _text(d["reference"], 512),
        _choice(d["outcome"], {"pass", "fail", "observed", "not_run"}),
        _text(d["details"]),
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Result:
    schema_version: int
    assignment_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    attempt_id: str
    requested_model: str
    resolved_model: str
    execution_state: str
    semantic_verdict: str
    admission_state: str
    summary: str
    artifacts: tuple[str, ...]
    evidence: tuple[Evidence, ...]
    unverified_claims: tuple[str, ...]
    remaining_risks: tuple[str, ...]
    usage: Usage | None


def parse_result(value: Any, *, assignment: Assignment) -> Result:
    assignment = _assignment_shape(to_wire(assignment))
    d = _record(value, "schema_version assignment_id task_id job_id attempt_id "
                "requested_model resolved_model execution_state semantic_verdict "
                "admission_state summary artifacts evidence unverified_claims "
                "remaining_risks usage")
    result = Result(
        1, *(_identifier(d[k]) for k in ("assignment_id", "task_id", "job_id",
                                        "attempt_id", "requested_model",
                                        "resolved_model")),
        _choice(d["execution_state"], {"completed", "failed", "timed_out",
                                      "interrupted", "cancelled", "invalid"}),
        _choice(d["semantic_verdict"], {"pass", "ready", "ready-with-corrections",
                                       "not-ready", "blocked", "reject",
                                       "not-applicable"}),
        _choice(d["admission_state"], {"unverified"}), _text(d["summary"]),
        _sequence(d["artifacts"], relative_path),
        _sequence(d["evidence"], _evidence),
        _sequence(d["unverified_claims"], _text),
        _sequence(d["remaining_risks"], _text), parse_usage(d["usage"]),
    )
    if any(getattr(result, k) != getattr(assignment, k)
           for k in ("assignment_id", "task_id", "job_id", "attempt_id",
                     "requested_model")):
        reject("identity_mismatch")
    if result.resolved_model != assignment.requested_model:
        reject("model_mismatch")
    criteria = tuple(e.criterion_id for e in result.evidence)
    if (len(criteria) != len(set(criteria))
            or not set(criteria) <= set(assignment.required_evidence)):
        reject("invalid_evidence")
    if result.execution_state == "completed":
        if set(criteria) != set(assignment.required_evidence):
            reject("missing_evidence")
    if result.semantic_verdict in {"pass", "ready"}:
        if (result.execution_state != "completed" or result.unverified_claims
                or result.remaining_risks
                or any(e.outcome not in {"pass", "observed"} for e in result.evidence)):
            reject("inconsistent_verdict")
    return result

"""Pure offline checks. Success validates fixtures and never permits execution."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from .contracts import (
    READ_TOOLS, ROLES, Assignment, BillingObservation, ParentGrant, Task,
    VersionObservation, _record, parse_assignment, parse_billing_observation,
    parse_parent_grant, parse_task, parse_version_observation, reject, relative_path,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FixtureReadiness:
    task: Task
    parent: ParentGrant
    assignment: Assignment
    version: VersionObservation
    billing: BillingObservation
    runtime_enabled: bool = field(default=False, init=False)


def assess_fixture_readiness(value: Any) -> FixtureReadiness:
    """Synthetic structural readiness only: no real attestation or admission API."""
    d = _record(value, "schema_version task parent_grant assignment version billing")
    task = parse_task(d["task"])
    parent = parse_parent_grant(d["parent_grant"])
    assignment = parse_assignment(d["assignment"], task=task, parent=parent)
    version = parse_version_observation(d["version"])
    billing = parse_billing_observation(d["billing"])
    for observation in (version, billing):
        if (observation.assignment_id != assignment.assignment_id
                or observation.attempt_id != assignment.attempt_id):
            reject("observation_mismatch")
    if assignment.lifecycle_state != "pre-send":
        reject("attempt_not_pre_send")
    if (version.source != "synthetic" or version.channel != "latest"
            or version.client_version is None
            or version.client_version != version.latest_version
            or not version.fresh or not version.capabilities_verified):
        reject("version_unverified")
    if (billing.source != "synthetic" or billing.provider != "first_party"
            or billing.auth_method != "claude.ai"
            or billing.billing_mode != "subscription"
            or billing.usage_credits != "disabled"
            or billing.entitlement != "available" or not billing.fresh):
        reject("billing_unverified")
    return FixtureReadiness(task, parent, assignment, version, billing)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NativeFixture:
    name: str
    description: str
    tools: tuple[str, ...]
    body: str
    runtime_enabled: bool = field(default=False, init=False)


_HEADER = re.compile(r"([a-z]+): ([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 ,._/-]{0,511})\Z")
_LINK = re.compile(r"!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)")


def parse_native_fixture(text: Any) -> NativeFixture:
    """Parse our three-key scalar YAML subset, not general YAML or native discovery.

    Model omission in this inert fixture does not establish native model isolation.
    Body content is untrusted text and cannot grant tools, permissions or admission.
    """
    if type(text) is not str or len(text) > 16384 or "\r" in text:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if (len(lines) < 6 or lines[0] != "---"
            or any(ord(c) < 32 and c != "\n" for c in text)):
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    try:
        boundary = lines.index("---", 1)
    except ValueError:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    header = {}
    for line in lines[1:boundary]:
        match = _HEADER.fullmatch(line)
        if not match or match[1] in header:
            reject("invalid_native_header")
        header[match[1]] = match[2]
    if set(header) != {"name", "description", "tools"} or header["name"] not in ROLES:
        reject("invalid_native_header")
    tools = tuple(p.strip() for p in header["tools"].split(","))
    if (not tools or len(tools) != len(set(tools)) or not set(tools) <= READ_TOOLS):
        reject("native_tools_denied")
    body = "\n".join(lines[boundary + 1:]).strip()
    if not body:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    for link in _LINK.findall(body):
        relative_path(link)
    return NativeFixture(header["name"], header["description"], tools, body)


def validate_native_inventory(texts: Any) -> tuple[NativeFixture, ...]:
    """Validate exactly one inert definition for each package role."""
    if type(texts) is not list or len(texts) != len(ROLES):
        reject("invalid_native_inventory")
    fixtures = tuple(parse_native_fixture(text) for text in texts)
    names = tuple(f.name for f in fixtures)
    if len(names) != len(set(names)) or set(names) != ROLES:
        reject("invalid_native_inventory")
    return fixtures

"""Offline contracts only; no provider, installer, or execution surface."""

__version__ = "0.0.0"

"""Closed, immutable fixture contracts; parsed observations are never authority."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any, Callable

SYNTHETIC_MODEL = "fixture-claude-v1"
MAX_JSON_DEPTH = 32
READ_TOOLS = frozenset({"Read", "Glob", "Grep"})
ROLES = frozenset({
    "claude_agents_researcher", "claude_agents_planner",
    "claude_agents_implementation_worker", "claude_agents_security_reviewer",
    "claude_agents_verification_worker",
})
STATES = frozenset({"pre-send", "sent", "acknowledged", "terminal", "ambiguous"})
_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}\Z")
_VERSION = re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{1,5}\Z")
_PATH_PART = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}\Z")


class ContractError(ValueError):
    """Content-free code: callers must not append rejected input to diagnostics."""

    def __init__(self, code: str) -> None:
        self.code = code
        super().__init__(code)


def reject(code: str) -> None:
    raise ContractError(code)


def _record(value: Any, fields: str, *, versioned: bool = True) -> dict:
    if type(value) is not dict or set(value) != set(fields.split()):
        reject("invalid_fields")
    if versioned and (type(value["schema_version"]) is not int
                      or value["schema_version"] != 1):
        reject("unsupported_schema")
    return value


def _text(value: Any, maximum: int = 4096) -> str:
    if (type(value) is not str or not value.strip() or len(value) > maximum
            or any(ord(c) < 32 and c not in "\n\t" for c in value)):
        reject("invalid_text")
    return value


def _identifier(value: Any) -> str:
    if type(value) is not str or not _ID.fullmatch(value):
        reject("invalid_identifier")
    return value


def relative_path(value: Any) -> str:
    """Canonical literal root-relative token, not a filesystem reference monitor."""
    if (type(value) is not str or len(value) > 256
            or any(p in {"", ".", ".."} or not _PATH_PART.fullmatch(p)
                   for p in value.split("/"))):
        reject("invalid_path")
    return value


def _choice(value: Any, choices: set | frozenset) -> str:
    if type(value) is not str or value not in choices:
        reject("unsupported_value")
    return value


def _integer(value: Any, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> int:
    if type(value) is not int or not minimum <= value <= maximum:
        reject("invalid_number")
    return value


def _boolean(value: Any) -> bool:
    if type(value) is not bool:
        reject("invalid_boolean")
    return value


def _sequence(value: Any, parser: Callable, minimum: int = 0,
              maximum: int = 32) -> tuple:
    if type(value) is not list or not minimum <= len(value) <= maximum:
        reject("invalid_array")
    result = tuple(parser(item) for item in value)
    if len(result) != len(set(result)):
        reject("duplicate_item")
    return result


def _empty(value: Any) -> tuple:
    if type(value) is not list or value:
        reject("capability_denied")
    return ()


def _disabled(value: Any) -> bool:
    if _boolean(value):
        reject("capability_denied")
    return False


def _version(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if type(value) is not str or not _VERSION.fullmatch(value):
        reject("invalid_version")
    return value


def safe_load_json(text: str) -> Any:
    """Bound input/depth; reject duplicate keys and floating/nonfinite numbers."""
    if type(text) is not str or len(text) > 131072:
        reject("invalid_json")
    depth, quoted, escaped = 0, False, False
    for character in text:
        if quoted:
            if escaped:
                escaped = False
            elif character == "\\":
                escaped = True
            elif character == '"':
                quoted = False
        elif character == '"':
            quoted = True
        elif character in "[{":
            depth += 1
            if depth > MAX_JSON_DEPTH:
                reject("invalid_json")
        elif character in "]}":
            depth -= 1

    def pairs(items: list) -> dict:
        result = {}
        for key, value in items:
            if key in result:
                reject("duplicate_key")
            result[key] = value
        return result

    def number(_: str) -> None:
        reject("invalid_number")

    try:
        return json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_float=number,
                          parse_constant=number)
    except (ValueError, RecursionError) as exc:
        if isinstance(exc, ContractError):
            raise
        raise ContractError("invalid_json") from None


def to_wire(value: Any) -> dict:
    """Return a detached JSON-shaped copy; tuple fields become arrays."""
    try:
        return json.loads(json.dumps(asdict(value), allow_nan=False))
    except (TypeError, ValueError, RecursionError):
        raise ContractError("invalid_contract") from None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Bounds:
    max_attempts: int
    timeout_seconds: int
    max_tool_calls: int
    max_no_progress_events: int


def _bounds(value: Any) -> Bounds:
    d = _record(value, "max_attempts timeout_seconds max_tool_calls "
                "max_no_progress_events", versioned=False)
    return Bounds(_integer(d["max_attempts"], 1, 1),
                  _integer(d["timeout_seconds"], 1, 3600),
                  _integer(d["max_tool_calls"], 0, 128),
                  _integer(d["max_no_progress_events"], 1, 16))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Capabilities:
    tools: tuple[str, ...]
    read_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    network: bool
    mcps: tuple
    hooks: tuple
    secrets: tuple
    external_effects: bool


def _capabilities(value: Any) -> Capabilities:
    d = _record(value, "tools read_paths network mcps hooks secrets external_effects",
                versioned=False)
    return Capabilities(
        _sequence(d["tools"], lambda v: _choice(v, READ_TOOLS), maximum=3),
        _sequence(d["read_paths"], relative_path),
        _disabled(d["network"]), _empty(d["mcps"]), _empty(d["hooks"]),
        _empty(d["secrets"]), _disabled(d["external_effects"]),
    )

class Task:

    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    objective: str
    family: str
    owned_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    required_evidence: tuple[str, ...]


def parse_task(value: Any) -> Task:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version task_id job_id objective family owned_paths "
                "required_evidence")
    return Task(
        1, _identifier(d["task_id"]), _identifier(d["job_id"]),
        _text(d["objective"]),
        _choice(d["family"], {"inventory", "research", "planning", "coding",
                             "documentation", "security", "verification"}),
        _sequence(d["owned_paths"], relative_path, 1),
        _sequence(d["required_evidence"], _identifier, 1),
    )

class ParentGrant:

    task_id: str

def parse_parent_grant(value: Any) -> ParentGrant:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version grant_id task_id job_id capabilities bounds")
    return ParentGrant(1, _identifier(d["grant_id"]), _identifier(d["task_id"]),
                       _identifier(d["job_id"]), _capabilities(d["capabilities"]),
                       _bounds(d["bounds"]))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Assignment:
    schema_version: int
    assignment_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    attempt_id: str
    attempt: int
    parent_grant_id: str
    role: str
    requested_model: str
    context_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    capabilities: Capabilities
    bounds: Bounds
    required_evidence: tuple[str, ...]
    lifecycle_state: str


def _assignment_shape(value: Any) -> Assignment:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version assignment_id task_id job_id attempt_id "
                "attempt parent_grant_id role requested_model context_paths "
                "capabilities bounds required_evidence lifecycle_state")
    a = Assignment(
        1, _identifier(d["assignment_id"]), _identifier(d["task_id"]),
        _identifier(d["job_id"]), _identifier(d["attempt_id"]),
        _integer(d["attempt"], 1, 1), _identifier(d["parent_grant_id"]),
        _choice(d["role"], ROLES), _identifier(d["requested_model"]),
        _sequence(d["context_paths"], relative_path),
        _capabilities(d["capabilities"]), _bounds(d["bounds"]),
        _sequence(d["required_evidence"], _identifier, 1),
        _choice(d["lifecycle_state"], STATES),
    )
    if a.requested_model != SYNTHETIC_MODEL:
        reject("synthetic_model_required")
    return a


def parse_assignment(value: Any, *, task: Task, parent: ParentGrant) -> Assignment:
    task = parse_task(to_wire(task))
    parent = parse_parent_grant(to_wire(parent))
    a = _assignment_shape(value)
    if (a.task_id != task.task_id or a.job_id != task.job_id
            or parent.task_id != task.task_id or parent.job_id != task.job_id
            or a.parent_grant_id != parent.grant_id):
        reject("identity_mismatch")
    if a.required_evidence != task.required_evidence:
        reject("evidence_mismatch")
    if (not set(a.capabilities.tools) <= set(parent.capabilities.tools)
            or not set(a.capabilities.read_paths) <= set(parent.capabilities.read_paths)
            or not set(a.context_paths) <= set(a.capabilities.read_paths)
            or not set(a.capabilities.read_paths) <= set(task.owned_paths)):
        reject("grant_expansion")
    if any(v > getattr(parent.bounds, key)
           for key, v in asdict(a.bounds).items()):
        reject("bound_expansion")
    return a


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Usage:
    schema_version: int
    source: str
    coverage: str
    input_tokens: int | None
    cached_tokens: int | None
    output_tokens: int | None
    reasoning_tokens: int | None
    tool_calls: int | None
    latency_ms: int | None


def parse_usage(value: Any) -> Usage | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    names = ("input_tokens", "cached_tokens", "output_tokens",
             "reasoning_tokens", "tool_calls", "latency_ms")
    d = _record(value, "schema_version source coverage " + " ".join(names))
    source = _choice(d["source"], {"synthetic", "unavailable"})
    coverage = _choice(d["coverage"], {"unknown", "partial", "complete"})
    numbers = tuple(None if d[k] is None else _integer(d[k], 0, 1000000000)
                    for k in names)
    if (source == "unavailable" and (coverage != "unknown"
                                    or any(v is not None for v in numbers))):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    if coverage == "unknown" and any(v is not None for v in numbers):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    if coverage == "complete" and any(v is None for v in numbers):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    for total, subset in ((numbers[0], numbers[1]), (numbers[2], numbers[3])):
        if subset is not None and (total is None or subset > total):
            reject("invalid_usage_subset")
    return Usage(1, source, coverage, *numbers)

    return Evidence(

        _choice(d["type"], {"command", "source", "artifact", "review", "observation"}),

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Result:
    schema_version: int
    assignment_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    attempt_id: str
    requested_model: str
    resolved_model: str
    execution_state: str
    semantic_verdict: str
    admission_state: str
    summary: str
    artifacts: tuple[str, ...]
    evidence: tuple[Evidence, ...]
    unverified_claims: tuple[str, ...]
    remaining_risks: tuple[str, ...]
    usage: Usage | None


def parse_result(value: Any, *, assignment: Assignment) -> Result:
    assignment = _assignment_shape(to_wire(assignment))
    d = _record(value, "schema_version assignment_id task_id job_id attempt_id "
                "requested_model resolved_model execution_state semantic_verdict "
                "admission_state summary artifacts evidence unverified_claims "
                "remaining_risks usage")
    result = Result(
        1, *(_identifier(d[k]) for k in ("assignment_id", "task_id", "job_id",
                                        "attempt_id", "requested_model",
                                        "resolved_model")),
        _choice(d["execution_state"], {"completed", "failed", "timed_out",
                                      "interrupted", "cancelled", "invalid"}),
        _choice(d["semantic_verdict"], {"pass", "ready", "ready-with-corrections",
                                       "not-ready", "blocked", "reject",
                                       "not-applicable"}),
        _choice(d["admission_state"], {"unverified"}), _text(d["summary"]),
        _sequence(d["artifacts"], relative_path),
        _sequence(d["evidence"], _evidence),
        _sequence(d["unverified_claims"], _text),
        _sequence(d["remaining_risks"], _text), parse_usage(d["usage"]),
    )
    if any(getattr(result, k) != getattr(assignment, k)
           for k in ("assignment_id", "task_id", "job_id", "attempt_id",
                     "requested_model")):
        reject("identity_mismatch")
    if result.resolved_model != assignment.requested_model:
        reject("model_mismatch")
    criteria = tuple(e.criterion_id for e in result.evidence)
    if (len(criteria) != len(set(criteria))
            or not set(criteria) <= set(assignment.required_evidence)):
        reject("invalid_evidence")
    if result.execution_state == "completed":
        if set(criteria) != set(assignment.required_evidence):
            reject("missing_evidence")
    if result.semantic_verdict in {"pass", "ready"}:
        if (result.execution_state != "completed" or result.unverified_claims
                or result.remaining_risks
                or any(e.outcome not in {"pass", "observed"} for e in result.evidence)):
            reject("inconsistent_verdict")
    return result

"""Pure offline checks. Success validates fixtures and never permits execution."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from .contracts import (
    READ_TOOLS, ROLES, Assignment, BillingObservation, ParentGrant, Task,
    VersionObservation, _record, parse_assignment, parse_billing_observation,
    parse_parent_grant, parse_task, parse_version_observation, reject, relative_path,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FixtureReadiness:
    task: Task
    parent: ParentGrant
    assignment: Assignment
    version: VersionObservation
    billing: BillingObservation
    runtime_enabled: bool = field(default=False, init=False)


def assess_fixture_readiness(value: Any) -> FixtureReadiness:
    """Synthetic structural readiness only: no real attestation or admission API."""
    d = _record(value, "schema_version task parent_grant assignment version billing")
    task = parse_task(d["task"])
    parent = parse_parent_grant(d["parent_grant"])
    assignment = parse_assignment(d["assignment"], task=task, parent=parent)
    version = parse_version_observation(d["version"])
    billing = parse_billing_observation(d["billing"])
    for observation in (version, billing):
        if (observation.assignment_id != assignment.assignment_id
                or observation.attempt_id != assignment.attempt_id):
            reject("observation_mismatch")
    if assignment.lifecycle_state != "pre-send":
        reject("attempt_not_pre_send")
    if (version.source != "synthetic" or version.channel != "latest"
            or version.client_version is None
            or version.client_version != version.latest_version
            or not version.fresh or not version.capabilities_verified):
        reject("version_unverified")
    if (billing.source != "synthetic" or billing.provider != "first_party"
            or billing.auth_method != "claude.ai"
            or billing.billing_mode != "subscription"
            or billing.usage_credits != "disabled"
            or billing.entitlement != "available" or not billing.fresh):
        reject("billing_unverified")
    return FixtureReadiness(task, parent, assignment, version, billing)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NativeFixture:
    name: str
    description: str
    tools: tuple[str, ...]
    body: str
    runtime_enabled: bool = field(default=False, init=False)


_HEADER = re.compile(r"([a-z]+): ([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 ,._/-]{0,511})\Z")
_LINK = re.compile(r"!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)")


def parse_native_fixture(text: Any) -> NativeFixture:
    """Parse our three-key scalar YAML subset, not general YAML or native discovery.

    Model omission in this inert fixture does not establish native model isolation.
    Body content is untrusted text and cannot grant tools, permissions or admission.
    """
    if type(text) is not str or len(text) > 16384 or "\r" in text:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if (len(lines) < 6 or lines[0] != "---"
            or any(ord(c) < 32 and c != "\n" for c in text)):
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    try:
        boundary = lines.index("---", 1)
    except ValueError:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    header = {}
    for line in lines[1:boundary]:
        match = _HEADER.fullmatch(line)
        if not match or match[1] in header:
            reject("invalid_native_header")
        header[match[1]] = match[2]
    if set(header) != {"name", "description", "tools"} or header["name"] not in ROLES:
        reject("invalid_native_header")
    tools = tuple(p.strip() for p in header["tools"].split(","))
    if (not tools or len(tools) != len(set(tools)) or not set(tools) <= READ_TOOLS):
        reject("native_tools_denied")
    body = "\n".join(lines[boundary + 1:]).strip()
    if not body:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    for link in _LINK.findall(body):
        relative_path(link)
    return NativeFixture(header["name"], header["description"], tools, body)


def validate_native_inventory(texts: Any) -> tuple[NativeFixture, ...]:
    """Validate exactly one inert definition for each package role."""
    if type(texts) is not list or len(texts) != len(ROLES):
        reject("invalid_native_inventory")
    fixtures = tuple(parse_native_fixture(text) for text in texts)
    names = tuple(f.name for f in fixtures)
    if len(names) != len(set(names)) or set(names) != ROLES:
        reject("invalid_native_inventory")
    return fixtures

"""Offline contracts only; no provider, installer, or execution surface."""

__version__ = "0.0.0"

"""Closed, immutable fixture contracts; parsed observations are never authority."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any, Callable

SYNTHETIC_MODEL = "fixture-claude-v1"
MAX_JSON_DEPTH = 32
READ_TOOLS = frozenset({"Read", "Glob", "Grep"})
ROLES = frozenset({
    "claude_agents_researcher", "claude_agents_planner",
    "claude_agents_implementation_worker", "claude_agents_security_reviewer",
    "claude_agents_verification_worker",
})
STATES = frozenset({"pre-send", "sent", "acknowledged", "terminal", "ambiguous"})
_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}\Z")
_VERSION = re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{1,5}\Z")
_PATH_PART = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}\Z")


class ContractError(ValueError):
    """Content-free code: callers must not append rejected input to diagnostics."""

    def __init__(self, code: str) -> None:
        self.code = code
        super().__init__(code)


def reject(code: str) -> None:
    raise ContractError(code)


def _record(value: Any, fields: str, *, versioned: bool = True) -> dict:
    if type(value) is not dict or set(value) != set(fields.split()):
        reject("invalid_fields")
    if versioned and (type(value["schema_version"]) is not int
                      or value["schema_version"] != 1):
        reject("unsupported_schema")
    return value


def _text(value: Any, maximum: int = 4096) -> str:
    if (type(value) is not str or not value.strip() or len(value) > maximum
            or any(ord(c) < 32 and c not in "\n\t" for c in value)):
        reject("invalid_text")
    return value


def _identifier(value: Any) -> str:
    if type(value) is not str or not _ID.fullmatch(value):
        reject("invalid_identifier")
    return value


def relative_path(value: Any) -> str:
    """Canonical literal root-relative token, not a filesystem reference monitor."""
    if (type(value) is not str or len(value) > 256
            or any(p in {"", ".", ".."} or not _PATH_PART.fullmatch(p)
                   for p in value.split("/"))):
        reject("invalid_path")
    return value


def _choice(value: Any, choices: set | frozenset) -> str:
    if type(value) is not str or value not in choices:
        reject("unsupported_value")
    return value


def _integer(value: Any, minimum: int, maximum: int) -> int:
    if type(value) is not int or not minimum <= value <= maximum:
        reject("invalid_number")
    return value


def _boolean(value: Any) -> bool:
    if type(value) is not bool:
        reject("invalid_boolean")
    return value


def _sequence(value: Any, parser: Callable, minimum: int = 0,
              maximum: int = 32) -> tuple:
    if type(value) is not list or not minimum <= len(value) <= maximum:
        reject("invalid_array")
    result = tuple(parser(item) for item in value)
    if len(result) != len(set(result)):
        reject("duplicate_item")
    return result


def _empty(value: Any) -> tuple:
    if type(value) is not list or value:
        reject("capability_denied")
    return ()


def _disabled(value: Any) -> bool:
    if _boolean(value):
        reject("capability_denied")
    return False


def _version(value: Any) -> str | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if type(value) is not str or not _VERSION.fullmatch(value):
        reject("invalid_version")
    return value


def safe_load_json(text: str) -> Any:
    """Bound input/depth; reject duplicate keys and floating/nonfinite numbers."""
    if type(text) is not str or len(text) > 131072:
        reject("invalid_json")
    depth, quoted, escaped = 0, False, False
    for character in text:
        if quoted:
            if escaped:
                escaped = False
            elif character == "\\":
                escaped = True
            elif character == '"':
                quoted = False
        elif character == '"':
            quoted = True
        elif character in "[{":
            depth += 1
            if depth > MAX_JSON_DEPTH:
                reject("invalid_json")
        elif character in "]}":
            depth -= 1

    def pairs(items: list) -> dict:
        result = {}
        for key, value in items:
            if key in result:
                reject("duplicate_key")
            result[key] = value
        return result

    def number(_: str) -> None:
        reject("invalid_number")

    try:
        return json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_float=number,
                          parse_constant=number)
    except (ValueError, RecursionError) as exc:
        if isinstance(exc, ContractError):
            raise
        raise ContractError("invalid_json") from None


def to_wire(value: Any) -> dict:
    """Return a detached JSON-shaped copy; tuple fields become arrays."""
    try:
        return json.loads(json.dumps(asdict(value), allow_nan=False))
    except (TypeError, ValueError, RecursionError):
        raise ContractError("invalid_contract") from None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Bounds:
    max_attempts: int
    timeout_seconds: int
    max_tool_calls: int
    max_no_progress_events: int


def _bounds(value: Any) -> Bounds:
    d = _record(value, "max_attempts timeout_seconds max_tool_calls "
                "max_no_progress_events", versioned=False)
    return Bounds(_integer(d["max_attempts"], 1, 1),
                  _integer(d["timeout_seconds"], 1, 3600),
                  _integer(d["max_tool_calls"], 0, 128),
                  _integer(d["max_no_progress_events"], 1, 16))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Capabilities:
    tools: tuple[str, ...]
    read_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    network: bool
    mcps: tuple
    hooks: tuple
    secrets: tuple
    external_effects: bool


def _capabilities(value: Any) -> Capabilities:
    d = _record(value, "tools read_paths network mcps hooks secrets external_effects",
                versioned=False)
    return Capabilities(
        _sequence(d["tools"], lambda v: _choice(v, READ_TOOLS), maximum=3),
        _sequence(d["read_paths"], relative_path),
        _disabled(d["network"]), _empty(d["mcps"]), _empty(d["hooks"]),
        _empty(d["secrets"]), _disabled(d["external_effects"]),
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Task:
    schema_version: int
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    objective: str
    family: str
    owned_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    required_evidence: tuple[str, ...]


def parse_task(value: Any) -> Task:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version task_id job_id objective family owned_paths "
                "required_evidence")
    return Task(
        1, _identifier(d["task_id"]), _identifier(d["job_id"]),
        _text(d["objective"]),
        _choice(d["family"], {"inventory", "research", "planning", "coding",
                             "documentation", "security", "verification"}),
        _sequence(d["owned_paths"], relative_path, 1),
        _sequence(d["required_evidence"], _identifier, 1),
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ParentGrant:
    schema_version: int
    grant_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    capabilities: Capabilities
    bounds: Bounds


def parse_parent_grant(value: Any) -> ParentGrant:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version grant_id task_id job_id capabilities bounds")
    return ParentGrant(1, _identifier(d["grant_id"]), _identifier(d["task_id"]),
                       _identifier(d["job_id"]), _capabilities(d["capabilities"]),
                       _bounds(d["bounds"]))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Assignment:
    schema_version: int
    assignment_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    attempt_id: str
    attempt: int
    parent_grant_id: str
    role: str
    requested_model: str
    context_paths: tuple[str, ...]
    capabilities: Capabilities
    bounds: Bounds
    required_evidence: tuple[str, ...]
    lifecycle_state: str


def _assignment_shape(value: Any) -> Assignment:
    d = _record(value, "schema_version assignment_id task_id job_id attempt_id "
                "attempt parent_grant_id role requested_model context_paths "
                "capabilities bounds required_evidence lifecycle_state")
    a = Assignment(
        1, _identifier(d["assignment_id"]), _identifier(d["task_id"]),
        _identifier(d["job_id"]), _identifier(d["attempt_id"]),
        _integer(d["attempt"], 1, 1), _identifier(d["parent_grant_id"]),
        _choice(d["role"], ROLES), _identifier(d["requested_model"]),
        _sequence(d["context_paths"], relative_path),
        _capabilities(d["capabilities"]), _bounds(d["bounds"]),
        _sequence(d["required_evidence"], _identifier, 1),
        _choice(d["lifecycle_state"], STATES),
    )
    if a.requested_model != SYNTHETIC_MODEL:
        reject("synthetic_model_required")
    return a


def parse_assignment(value: Any, *, task: Task, parent: ParentGrant) -> Assignment:
    task = parse_task(to_wire(task))
    parent = parse_parent_grant(to_wire(parent))
    a = _assignment_shape(value)
    if (a.task_id != task.task_id or a.job_id != task.job_id
            or parent.task_id != task.task_id or parent.job_id != task.job_id
            or a.parent_grant_id != parent.grant_id):
        reject("identity_mismatch")
    if a.required_evidence != task.required_evidence:
        reject("evidence_mismatch")
    if (not set(a.capabilities.tools) <= set(parent.capabilities.tools)
            or not set(a.capabilities.read_paths) <= set(parent.capabilities.read_paths)
            or not set(a.context_paths) <= set(a.capabilities.read_paths)
            or not set(a.capabilities.read_paths) <= set(task.owned_paths)):
        reject("grant_expansion")
    if any(v > getattr(parent.bounds, key)
           for key, v in asdict(a.bounds).items()):
        reject("bound_expansion")
    return a


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Usage:
    schema_version: int
    source: str
    coverage: str
    input_tokens: int | None
    cached_tokens: int | None
    output_tokens: int | None
    reasoning_tokens: int | None
    tool_calls: int | None
    latency_ms: int | None


def parse_usage(value: Any) -> Usage | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    names = ("input_tokens", "cached_tokens", "output_tokens",
             "reasoning_tokens", "tool_calls", "latency_ms")
    d = _record(value, "schema_version source coverage " + " ".join(names))
    source = _choice(d["source"], {"synthetic", "unavailable"})
    coverage = _choice(d["coverage"], {"unknown", "partial", "complete"})
    numbers = tuple(None if d[k] is None else _integer(d[k], 0, 1000000000)
                    for k in names)
    if (source == "unavailable" and (coverage != "unknown"
                                    or any(v is not None for v in numbers))):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    if coverage == "unknown" and any(v is not None for v in numbers):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    if coverage == "complete" and any(v is None for v in numbers):
        reject("usage_provenance")
    for total, subset in ((numbers[0], numbers[1]), (numbers[2], numbers[3])):
        if subset is not None and (total is None or subset > total):
            reject("invalid_usage_subset")
    return Usage(1, source, coverage, *numbers)

    outcome: str
    details: str

    return Evidence(
        _identifier(d["criterion_id"]),
        _choice(d["type"], {"command", "source", "artifact", "review", "observation"}),

        _choice(d["outcome"], {"pass", "fail", "observed", "not_run"}),

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Result:
    schema_version: int
    assignment_id: str
    task_id: str
    job_id: str
    attempt_id: str
    requested_model: str
    resolved_model: str
    execution_state: str
    semantic_verdict: str
    admission_state: str
    summary: str
    artifacts: tuple[str, ...]
    evidence: tuple[Evidence, ...]
    unverified_claims: tuple[str, ...]
    remaining_risks: tuple[str, ...]
    usage: Usage | None


def parse_result(value: Any, *, assignment: Assignment) -> Result:
    assignment = _assignment_shape(to_wire(assignment))
    d = _record(value, "schema_version assignment_id task_id job_id attempt_id "
                "requested_model resolved_model execution_state semantic_verdict "
                "admission_state summary artifacts evidence unverified_claims "
                "remaining_risks usage")
    result = Result(
        1, *(_identifier(d[k]) for k in ("assignment_id", "task_id", "job_id",
                                        "attempt_id", "requested_model",
                                        "resolved_model")),
        _choice(d["execution_state"], {"completed", "failed", "timed_out",
                                      "interrupted", "cancelled", "invalid"}),
        _choice(d["semantic_verdict"], {"pass", "ready", "ready-with-corrections",
                                       "not-ready", "blocked", "reject",
                                       "not-applicable"}),
        _choice(d["admission_state"], {"unverified"}), _text(d["summary"]),
        _sequence(d["artifacts"], relative_path),
        _sequence(d["evidence"], _evidence),
        _sequence(d["unverified_claims"], _text),
        _sequence(d["remaining_risks"], _text), parse_usage(d["usage"]),
    )
    if any(getattr(result, k) != getattr(assignment, k)
           for k in ("assignment_id", "task_id", "job_id", "attempt_id",
                     "requested_model")):
        reject("identity_mismatch")
    if result.resolved_model != assignment.requested_model:
        reject("model_mismatch")
    criteria = tuple(e.criterion_id for e in result.evidence)
    if (len(criteria) != len(set(criteria))
            or not set(criteria) <= set(assignment.required_evidence)):
        reject("invalid_evidence")
    if result.execution_state == "completed":
        if set(criteria) != set(assignment.required_evidence):
            reject("missing_evidence")
    if result.semantic_verdict in {"pass", "ready"}:
        if (result.execution_state != "completed" or result.unverified_claims
                or result.remaining_risks
                or any(e.outcome not in {"pass", "observed"} for e in result.evidence)):
            reject("inconsistent_verdict")
    return result

"""Pure offline checks. Success validates fixtures and never permits execution."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any

from .contracts import (
    READ_TOOLS, ROLES, Assignment, BillingObservation, ParentGrant, Task,
    VersionObservation, _record, parse_assignment, parse_billing_observation,
    parse_parent_grant, parse_task, parse_version_observation, reject, relative_path,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FixtureReadiness:
    task: Task
    parent: ParentGrant
    assignment: Assignment
    version: VersionObservation
    billing: BillingObservation
    runtime_enabled: bool = field(default=False, init=False)


def assess_fixture_readiness(value: Any) -> FixtureReadiness:
    """Synthetic structural readiness only: no real attestation or admission API."""
    d = _record(value, "schema_version task parent_grant assignment version billing")
    task = parse_task(d["task"])
    parent = parse_parent_grant(d["parent_grant"])
    assignment = parse_assignment(d["assignment"], task=task, parent=parent)
    version = parse_version_observation(d["version"])
    billing = parse_billing_observation(d["billing"])
    for observation in (version, billing):
        if (observation.assignment_id != assignment.assignment_id
                or observation.attempt_id != assignment.attempt_id):
            reject("observation_mismatch")
    if assignment.lifecycle_state != "pre-send":
        reject("attempt_not_pre_send")
    if (version.source != "synthetic" or version.channel != "latest"
            or version.client_version is None
            or version.client_version != version.latest_version
            or not version.fresh or not version.capabilities_verified):
        reject("version_unverified")
    if (billing.source != "synthetic" or billing.provider != "first_party"
            or billing.auth_method != "claude.ai"
            or billing.billing_mode != "subscription"
            or billing.usage_credits != "disabled"
            or billing.entitlement != "available" or not billing.fresh):
        reject("billing_unverified")
    return FixtureReadiness(task, parent, assignment, version, billing)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NativeFixture:
    name: str
    description: str
    tools: tuple[str, ...]
    body: str
    runtime_enabled: bool = field(default=False, init=False)


_HEADER = re.compile(r"([a-z]+): ([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 ,._/-]{0,511})\Z")
_LINK = re.compile(r"!?\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)")


def parse_native_fixture(text: Any) -> NativeFixture:
    """Parse our three-key scalar YAML subset, not general YAML or native discovery.

    Model omission in this inert fixture does not establish native model isolation.
    Body content is untrusted text and cannot grant tools, permissions or admission.
    """
    if type(text) is not str or len(text) > 16384 or "\r" in text:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    lines = text.splitlines()
    if (len(lines) < 6 or lines[0] != "---"
            or any(ord(c) < 32 and c != "\n" for c in text)):
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    try:
        boundary = lines.index("---", 1)
    except ValueError:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    header = {}
    for line in lines[1:boundary]:
        match = _HEADER.fullmatch(line)
        if not match or match[1] in header:
            reject("invalid_native_header")
        header[match[1]] = match[2]
    if set(header) != {"name", "description", "tools"} or header["name"] not in ROLES:
        reject("invalid_native_header")
    tools = tuple(p.strip() for p in header["tools"].split(","))
    if (not tools or len(tools) != len(set(tools)) or not set(tools) <= READ_TOOLS):
        reject("native_tools_denied")
    body = "\n".join(lines[boundary + 1:]).strip()
    if not body:
        reject("invalid_native_fixture")
    for link in _LINK.findall(body):
        relative_path(link)
    return NativeFixture(header["name"], header["description"], tools, body)


def validate_native_inventory(texts: Any) -> tuple[NativeFixture, ...]:
    """Validate exactly one inert definition for each package role."""
    if type(texts) is not list or len(texts) != len(ROLES):
        reject("invalid_native_inventory")
    fixtures = tuple(parse_native_fixture(text) for text in texts)
    names = tuple(f.name for f in fixtures)
    if len(names) != len(set(names)) or set(names) != ROLES:
        reject("invalid_native_inventory")
    return fixtures
